Name: Kitchen sink
Description: A stainless kitchen sink and its mixer tap (RunningWaterSpec.KitchenSink, RunningWaterSynth). Off until somebody turns it on with the interact key standing at it; the plug starts in, so the tap runs onto the steel and the bowl fills and stands full when it is shut. Shift+E at the sink facing it works the plug: pulled, the bowl drains through its strainer, gurgling as it empties. Place it over the sink at rim height. Not a recording and not a loop.
